title: Chapter 261
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

Dark, damp.

A rotten smell filled the air, and the cold air penetrated deep into the bones.

In the pitch-black cave, a petite body curled up like a cub, shivering slightly.

Aurora carefully tore open a bag of military biscuits. Her actions were very slow, and she had to pause for a while after tearing open every bit, worried that she would make a sound and attract the enemy. After opening the package, she took small bites of the hard biscuits, and it took her a long time to finish them.

In reality, this little bit of sound would not come out of the cave, but she still remembered Han Xiao's instructions and did not dare to make a sound.

This is already the thirteenth meal … Aurora thought to herself.

She did not know the passage of time in the cave, so she ate when she was hungry. She could only judge the time by the number of meals she ate.

A pair of bright eyes were hidden in the darkness, looking in the direction of the cave entrance.

In the cave, there was only a pile of supplies, the sound of breathing and heartbeat, and the wait that could not be seen …

…

A few days later, at the Stardragon frontline on the battlefield south of Andrea.

The fleet stopped inside the camp, and everyone sat or stood, waiting in boredom.

Little Spark spun between her fingers like a fairy. After playing with it for a while, Anna asked impatiently, "We've been waiting for 22 days.

"We've been here for 22 hours. How much longer do we have to wait?"

"Don't worry, it should be soon." Han Xiao puffed on the cigarette in his mouth.

After breaking through the leader's ambush, there were no more accidents along the way. They successfully passed through the Germinal Organization's territory and arrived at the Six Nations' territory. Their original destination was a temporary base of the Six Nations on the battlefield south, but Han Xiao suddenly requested to stop at this camp, saying that he was waiting for someone.

Since they were already safe, the experts of the Six Nations naturally had no objections. The reason why they did not leave was because they still had a mission, which was to supervise Han Xiao to hand over the intelligence to the Six Nations. Because this was a very important matter, the Six Nations had to be prepared for any eventuality …

On the side, Hella anxiously paced back and forth, looking at the entrance of the camp.

The soldiers who passed by all looked at them with reverence. Normally, they would not see so many big shots.

Suddenly, there was a commotion at the entrance of the camp.

Hella stopped in her tracks and looked over nervously.

The soldier on duty opened the door, and a man wearing a hooded robe slowly walked in while holding the hand of a little girl. The little girl's face was pale due to lack of nutrition. She looked around curiously, and when she saw Hella, she could not move her eyes away.

They were Dean and Aurora.

Hella strode forward and pulled Aurora into her arms. She hugged her tightly for a while until Aurora was almost out of breath. Then, she squatted down and touched Aurora's face. She carefully looked at her. Seeing that Aurora was unharmed, she immediately breathed a sigh of relief. Then, she saw Aurora's pale face and said apologetically, "I'm sorry, I will never leave you behind again."

Aurora wiped her eyes with the back of her hand and revealed a big smile.

His contagious smile seemed to brighten up the entire world.

"I knew that you would definitely come and get me."

Seeing that her sister was safe, Hella felt relieved. Suddenly, she felt that the wind was so gentle, and the sun was so bright.

The aura of freedom.

On the other side, Dean found Han Xiao and said, "I did not disappoint you."

Dean's stealth ability was the best for sneaking into all kinds of dangerous places. According to the coordinates given by Han Xiao, he found Aurora and brought her out. Ever since the failure to ambush Han Xiao, the Germinal Organization's alert level had plummeted, so the two of them were not in danger.

"Thanks." Han Xiao nodded and smiled. "I'm sorry for making you take such a risk. I owe you one."

"It's okay. You saved me once. Consider it my repayment. It's nothing." Dean waved his hand. "And compared to you sneaking into the Germinal Organization's headquarters, this small matter is nothing."

Han Xiao chatted for a while and got down to business. "Have you prepared the goods I asked for?"

"According to your request, I have ordered my subordinates to pick up the goods from the warehouse and ship them directly to Southern Continent. You can get them when you go back."

"Okay, I will settle the payment when the time comes."

After chatting for a while, Dean left. Danny said helplessly, "Can we go now?"

"Wait a moment." Han Xiao walked toward Hila and Aurora. The two sisters were still talking, but when he got closer, he suddenly heard Aurora ask a question.

"Sister, where are we going next?" Aurora had a hopeful look on her face.

Hella suddenly paused.
